cost.measurement: Existing reader enumerates the immutable selected tree; parses one bounded committed SCIP index, generated Go definitions and unique source proto; caches parsed proto fields for that invocation; re-reads each source document with emitted facts. No child/network/DB. Public5reads161951B/1665us; neutral5reads59966B/315us. Times are wall time for extractor plus test-corpus and streaming callback verification, not isolated extractor CPU or production latency. Corpus.Read hashes each read content; the callback additionally hashes the entire fact.Path source and checks both line-prefix counts once per emitted fact, including all generated-file emissions (25total public facts and24total neutral facts). These are finite harness observations, not a ceiling or SLO.

No new broad cache, full-corpus hash, lock or parallel execution in production. Frozen-input preflight, descriptor and exact definition-witness checks run outside the timed extractor-plus-callback region; test-corpus hashing and callback source hashing/line-prefix verification are included in that wall time.
